newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dickson Concepts says to list ST Dupont.
newsitem.headline: Dickson Concepts says to list ST Dupont.

text.p: Hong Kong retailer Dickson Concepts plans to list its wholly-owned subsidiary S.T. Dupont on the Paris stock exchange, group chairman Dickson Poon told reporters on Wednesday.

S.T. Dupont is a manufacturer and distributor of luxury lighters, writing instruments and other goods. The unit also owns and franchises boutiques and sales counters, distributing its products through 6,000 retail outlets worldwide.
Merrill Lynch International has been appointed to act as the global coordinator for the offer, a Dickson Concepts statement said.
"The listing will enhance the international profile of S.T. Dupont and will provide it with a new channel of asset to tap for its further expansion," the statement said.
